{"reason": "All 4 stockouts were medium-level with tiny inventory (2.8, 5.3d): alerting medium below 6 days fixes these (35000 vs 195000). Costly rows at 10-13.2d had regular-lead 4-8 covering demand, so >=9d goes to monitor (0 vs 45000, e.g. the 11.5/12.4/13.2 rows). A 6-9d rebalance branch cuts 45000 switches to 6000.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 9))
     (list 'propose-internal-rebalance))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
